title: Wing Junction Harnesses — Flap Area and Distribution Contactor Feeds

ata.title: Centre Fuselage Wiring — Wing Junction Harnesses

abstract: Wiring sheet for the wing junction harnesses feeding the right flap area equipment and the distribution contactors, with the bonding arrangement at the junction rail.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the wing junction harnesses between the centre fuselage and the right flap area, with the distribution contactor feeds, the connector list and the bonding arrangement at the junction rail.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn looking outboard from the junction rail. The contactor feeds are heavy gauge and are shown with their bonding class at each termination; a class one bond must be measured after any disturbance, and the value recorded against the sheet reference. The harness serving the flap area equipment is shown with its drip loop at the wing junction seal, which is the only place on this sheet where water ingress has been reported.
sections.routing_note: Runs leave the junction rail in zone 623 and pass outboard through the wing junction seal into zone 663, supported at 200 millimetre intervals with a drip loop immediately outboard of the seal. The contactor feed and the flap area harness share the same support brackets but must stay in separate bundles.
